items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I thought he was Vernel's brother for a while.

ctx.x: And then they had another old boy, I can't think of his name... Vernel used to call him his brother. He looked something like Vernel. But he left there and went to Oregon. Maybe you'd recognize his name. But he was a good piano player. He looked something like Vernel. And I thought he was Vernel's brother for a while.
